Nokogiri: XML::Schema on JRuby allows network requests when NONET is set, bypassing CVE-2020-26247

Aliases: CVE-2026-57234

Severity: CVSS_V3: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:L/UI:R/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N

Affected:

  • nokogiri — fixed in 1.19.4

As a result, a schema parsed with default options could still cause external resources to be fetched over the network, potentially enabling SSRF or XXE attacks. When `NONET` is enabled, only local resources (a `file:` scheme, or a relative or absolute path with no scheme) are resolved, and every network scheme is blocked, case-insensitively.
